We are trying to close the PO but finance is doing an ad-hoc audit on that line item. A few quick asks so procurement can evaluate:
- Exact token amount / dollar equivalent you propose for the temporary grant
- Desired duration (you mentioned 5–7 days — please confirm)
- Any additional legal terms or SOWs we need to review (redlines slow us down)
- Confirm this is a voucher and won’t change invoicing or require a credit memo unless the PO arrives late

If this is just a short sandbox voucher with a clear 5-day expiry and no change to invoicing, procurement can typically accept that after we confirm the token amount. Otherwise I’ll need to route to legal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our goal is to keep the evaluation moving.
